text: なんじゃ…　つまらん　きく　きに　なったら　きてくれい！

structure.jp: きく　きに　なったら

patterns.name: 〜気になる
patterns.span: きく　きに　なったら
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus きに　なる means 'come to feel like doing it'. きく　きに　なったら = 'when you get in the mood to listen'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'when or if that has happened'. なったら = 'when it has become so'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus くれ is a blunt man's request, 'do it for me'. くれい is an old-man drawn-out form. きてくれい = 'come, will you!'.
